name: direct left open
speaker: Cole
line: Cole at Drydock, east slip. direct left open. 7 steps. The hydrant stays for the hold.

speaker: Ada
line: Ada: Hold the hydrant at Drydock. Nobody past the east slip. We hold in 8 steps. Direct on the left lane, open.

name: Drydock east slip
speaker: Bess
line: Drydock east slip. Bess keeps the hydrant for the hold. 2 steps, direct on the left lane, open.
